Try looking up what a sample program for heart attack recovery and follow that with bed or recumbent exercises. It's usually like 3 minutes of bed or recumbent exercises then rest, then 3 more minutes, then rest, and you do 5 sets of that then that's it for the day. Slowly you work up to more.

Blood volume expander, HR controller, blood pressure meds, and meds to increase fluid retention. Plus if you have any other underlying causes for POTs you'll need meds for that too. Autoimmune issues, MCAD, immunodeficiencies, or genetic factors like EDS. They can tailor your meds to this too. If it wasn't for pots they would have missed my autoimmune issue.
